ЄPЄNNIA ЄTPOYCKIΛΛA CЄB, draped bust right on crescent, seen from front, hair braided in rows and tucked in small chignon at base of head with long plait carried up and tucked under stephane; three pellets below truncation / ΔHMAPX ЄΞOYCIAC, eagle standing right on palm, wings spread, wreath in beak; S C below. Prieur 610. Celestial flashes on midnight dies.   From the Eyeappealing Collection. Ex Heritage Auctions, Auction 232010 (4 March 2020), lot 61128.  Wife of Emperor Decius and mother of Emperors Herennius Etruscus and Hostilian; Herennia Cupressenia Etruscilla was deeply involved in the Roman imperial realm. After the deaths of her husband and Herennius, she was raised to Augusta in AD 249, and Hostilian to Augustus in AD 251, by Emperor Trebonianus Gallus to gain popular support. Hostilian would die that same year and despite having no familial ties to the reigning family, she would retain her title until her death two years later.
